snippet.title: S.M.P.C.U. | Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to S.M.P.C.U. (Special Monster Pest Control Unit) our horror coop game! 

Wishlist the game now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3996870/SMPCU__Special_Monster_Pest_Control_Unit/

and make sure to check our discord: https://discord.gg/QDw9FvPa5B
for more updates and previews!

---
S.M.P.C.U. is an online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. You and your friends are part of a pest control unit of the special kind! The “Special Monster Pest Control Unit” doesn’t bother with cockroaches or rats; there’s a far more dangerous task at hand! 

Extraterrestrial monsters have infested Earth's most sacred places - fast-food restaurants - and it is your job to get rid of them! 

Trap the sleeping monster by closing the portal it used to enter the pantry - the company will handle the rest. 
---
